findings.issue: Post-verification failure and render-count failure do not affect task/campaign success; protected frozen hashes are recorded but not compared as a success gate.
findings.reproduction: main() with all external actions mocked: run_task status passed, post_verify rc=1/report.passed=False, render matched=0 -> exit=0/campaign.status=passed. final_index mocked separately to isolate this gate.

findings.issue: Hashes campaign.json before adding final_index and writing it; fresh index always mismatches changed campaign.json. full_readback_passed is set before readback succeeds. Exception occurs in finally outside the status-failure handler.
findings.reproduction: Called real final_index_and_readback on temporary campaign with status=passed -> ValueError index readback mismatch: campaign.json; JSON still says full_readback_passed=True. Existing delivered index was separately verified valid; do not infer it is invalid.

findings.issue: run_task deletes an existing results directory, and create_clean removes an existing same-name container. Resume can rerun a completed workload after a post-verify failure, deleting its earlier evidence.
findings.reproduction: Static call-path inspection. No deletion or resume invoked.

findings.issue: Locked legal page checks text/shape count/notes only; changed background/text styling is accepted.
findings.reproduction: Actual delivered 029-u10 loaded in exact fixed-image Python; saved temporary copy with legal background changed to red and both legal text runs changed to red; validator errors=[]. Original artifact read-only and untouched.

minor_static_findings.issue: Convergence on final allowed iteration incorrectly marked stable=False; failure to converge also returns zero from this step instead of an explicit convergence error. Downstream TOC validation can reject mismatched output. Current archived runs converged at 2 and are unaffected.

Build checks base tag ID, but docker build does not pass immutable BASE_IMAGE build-arg; Dockerfile still uses mutable tag. Current recorded base ID is correct; future reproducibility should pin actual build input.

scope: No business-code edits, real workload/profiler runs, image builds, original evidence changes, or report/HTML updates. Mocks, temporary JSON and one temporary PPT mutation only.
